description.narrative: Centrum för skogar och människor (RECOFTC) är en regional organisation som arbetar med samhälls-/kommunalt (commnunity) skogsbruk i Asien. RECOFTCs verksamhet är huvudsakligen inriktad på att främja skogar och folkens rättigheter till skogarna. Detta görs genom utbildning, rådgivning, forskning, publikationer osv.

The Center for forests and people (RECOFTC) is a regional organisation working with commnunity forestry in Asia. Their activities is mainly directed at promoting community forests and peoples rights to the forests. This is done by training, advise, research, publications etc.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: RECOFTC has assisted in establishing community forestry in Southeast Asia, contributed to capacity building in community forestry, developed new knowledge related to conflicts over natural resources which is an issue that should receive more attention according to RECOFTC and contributed to including community forestry aspects into decision making.
RECOFTC has contributed to securing formal tenure rights for local people in focal countries in which it has established formal Country Programs during the strategic phase. Securing formal tenure rights for local communities and indigenous people over forest resources is an important starting point in the work of RECOFTC. The organization and its partners have contributed to about 35,000 groups having been formalized with over 13 million hectares of forested landscape managed by them. The growth of CF in Cambodia can be used as an example—in 2007, when RECOFTC first established a presence in the country, there were no formalized CF:s; now there are 291 CF:s benefitting more than 70,000 local households and managing 258 000 hectares of forest. RECOFTC has been directly responsible for more than half of these, and has influenced the others indirectly through the dissemination of best practices and support to the national CF program.
•The organization has supported policy change through sharing lessons learned and best practices particularly through active participation in relevant committees, events and networks at national and regional levels. To illustrate RECOFTC played a key role supporting the development of the regional ASEAN Social Forestry Network (ASFN). ASFN is a government driven social forestry network in Southeast Asia, with the main goal to strengthen ASEAN Cooperation in Social Forestry through the sharing of information and knowledge.
•During the agreement period RECOFTC has been hosting Regional Forums for People and Forests and subsequent National Forums in Cambodia, Indonesia, Lao PDR, Myanmar, Thailand, and Vietnam, which brought together regional, national and grassroots stakeholders to develop joint national action plans to strengthen community forestry efforts.
•RECOFTC has engaged with national governments to develop or improve at least 26 legislative instruments (acts, regulations, decrees and directives) to strengthen pro-people regulatory frameworks in forestry sector in RECOFTC focal countries.
•More than 1300 capacity development events, reaching over 29 000 participants (30% of whom were women) have been delivered during the last five-year support.
